0022600033.text: The Spurs (5-2, on a five-game winning streak and 6th in the West) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-6, 15th in the West) in ninth-game Emirates NBA Cup West Group C action for San Antonio. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won all three meetings in 2025-26 by a combined 3-0, including a 130-103 win in San Antonio in their last matchup.
